relationship: Materializes the existing Lean powers-reuse candidate in Python. Only the order and right-hand sides of VAR power assignments change: powers 2,3,4,5 are built from the preceding power with the same left-associated multiplication tree. The original Python is unchanged. All constants (including unused ones), 29 repaired derivative coefficients, source INT64 casts, masks, strided upstream loads, old-gradient accumulation and stores are retained. Python function/call names are suffixed for the candidate; host guards and enable_fp_fusion=False are unchanged.
